tier_rationale: Operator seed assigned Tier 1 with classification 'Tier 1: Preferred clinical research partner (IND).' / 'Institutional (ICH Q7)' / 'Semaglutide, Thymosin Alpha-1.' Live profiling found this classification structurally inaccurate: oathpeptides.com is NXDOMAIN; the canonical brand resolves at oathpeptide.com (singular) which 301-redirects to oathresearch.com under a public 'Oath Peptides Is Now Oath Research' rebrand banner. The site is a US-based direct-to-researcher e-commerce shop (WooCommerce / Savoy theme) selling 26 retail-priced research-peptide SKUs ($10-$210 list), with no IND-grade institutional CDMO posture, no ICH Q7 documentation, no quote-gating, and no GMP claim — the on-site About page describes 'ISO-certified protocols' (not ICH Q7) for synthesis. Tier 1 is retained per directive Rule 17 because (a) the operator's seed assignment was Tier 1 and (b) the site exposes substantial schema-fillable depth (full SKU catalog, public TOS/Privacy/FAQ/COA index, batch-level on-site COAs from named third-party lab partner Freedom Diagnostics, full payment-method roster, US fulfillment address and phone, end-to-end policy text). The seed's institutional/IND framing should be treated as the operator's prior expectation, not as a fact the site supports — recorded here for §2.1 meta-synthesis A.meta.1 (high- vs low-trust patterns).
